import re
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_color_master_crud(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/master-data/color')
    page.click('button:has-text("Add Color Type")')
    page.fill('#colorName', 'Automated Color Test')
    page.click('button:has-text("Save")')
    expect(page.locator('table')).to_contain_text('Automated Color Test')
